identity.name: Telos
identity.definition: An independently governed, self-capitalized spot-BTC treasury system testing whether autonomous capital allocation can earn authority through evidence while remaining proof-bounded and survival-oriented.
identity.role_in_coherent_field: Telos gives Root Logos an economic and treasury expression through which claims about preservation, authority, evidence, and autonomy can meet material consequence.

governing_commitments: Human principal remains the ultimate authority.
Every proposed action requires intelligible reasons, explicit constraints, and reproducible evidence.
Authority may expand only after fixed tests pass.
Survival and bounded loss outrank capital ambition.
Strategy proposes, policy permits, execution acts, and audit records.
public_assertions: Telos is presently an experimental paper-only system.
BTC is the settled value layer and terminal accounting reference.
The system prefers no action when a complete route cannot be conservatively bounded and evidenced.
Current architecture does not provide Root Logos with custody, credentials, signing power, transfer capability, or trade authority.
Telos preserves content-addressed evidence and separates proposal, permission, execution, and audit.

work_relations.title: Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System
work_relations.statement: The Bitcoin white paper provides the public protocol architecture from which Telos names BTC as its settled value layer and terminal accounting reference.
work_relations.library_statement: This work grounds Telos’s declared BTC value layer; it grants no treasury authority.
work_relations.boundary: The white paper does not authorize Telos strategy, custody, execution, or claims of protocol identity. Telos does not alter the work’s source meaning.

exclusions: credentials, keys, signatures, and network allowlists
private strategy parameters and route details
orders, fills, transactions, tax records, and private evidence bundles
private repository contents beyond deliberately released public claims
questions: Can autonomous capital remain genuinely subordinate to evidence and preservation?
What treasury behavior would embody Root Logos without converting capital into constitutional authority?
Which proofs should be public before a treasury system may claim that its autonomy has matured?
